## Product
NexAgent OS runs an SME from one WhatsApp number: quotes, job cards, invoicing, stock, payroll and leads. Eight modules (M1–M8). No extra apps.

## Pricing (ZAR) — one plan only. Not VAT registered: prices are final, no VAT is added.
- Founder (first 10 clients): R2,999 setup (normally R4,999) + R1,999/month (standard R2,499/month). First payment R4,998. Founder price locked 12 months, then the standard monthly price at that time, with 30 days' written notice. After that, increases match the percentage rise in our costs (Make, Meta WhatsApp, PDF, AI, hosting), always with 30 days' written notice.
- Standard: R4,999 once-off setup + R2,499/month.
- Included every month: 300 AI chats and 60 jobs (a job is one quote-to-paid cycle).
- Top-ups: one R350 top-up pack adds +250 chats AND +50 jobs, one charge on the next invoice. No chat-only or job-only top-ups.
- Soft limit: usage is tracked per workshop and shown on the dashboard, with alerts at 80% and 100%. At 100% the AI keeps replying (never cut off) and the client is asked to top up. Usage resets monthly.
- WhatsApp messaging fees are included.
- Cancel any time: 20 working days' written notice by email to admin@rdinvestmentholdings.co.za. No cancellation fee. The 12-month Founder lock fixes the price only, not the contract.
- Pro rata: client pays only up to the last day of the notice period. Prepaid days after the end date are refunded.
- Setup fee: refunded on written request within 30 calendar days of go-live (first purchase only). Service stops and the SIM comes back.
- Terms: https://rdinvestmentholdings.co.za/terms.html#fair-use
